verdict.rationale: An AI-insights feature is a fair question for a remote-access SaaS with session and device data, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack shows AI-generated insights or suggestions inside AnyDesk. The REST API session-history export and the Python CSV module are building blocks a developer could feed to external AI, and the llms.txt docs file serves the help center to LLMs. Neither is an in-product AI insight capability.
